summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce filed a 424B5 product supplement for Autocallable Strategic Accelerated Redemption Securities (notes), unsecured senior debt linked to equity indices or ETFs. The notes do not guarantee principal and offer automatic call features with call premiums; at maturity, if not called, principal return depends on the underlying's performance with 1-to-1 downside below a threshold. Issuance is under Rule 424(b)(5) as a shelf takedown. No merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is involved. The filing is a routine structured note offering, not a special situation.
